title: Fitbit versa
body: How can I get readings from xdrip in my versa. I could with the dexcom app but I like this app better

comments.body: I'm using [Glance](https://github.com/Rytiggy/Glance); it reads your data from xdrip
Is that an app or a smart watch
It's a clock face that you can download to your Versa. Just go to "Clock faces" in the fitbit app on your phone and search for Glance

Thank you for the response.  OK I got it downloaded however everything but Blood Sugar is reading.  It reads DSE???

Not sure how to fix that

Thanks

Teri
